params.prompt: Photorealistic YouTube thumbnail portrait of Kim Jong Un, head and shoulders, facing the camera, head filling the frame, cropped at the chest, centered, dark Mao-style suit. A knowing, self-satisfied closed-mouth smirk, slightly narrowed eyes, confident. Background: a plain dark-grey smoky gradient like the reference image, soft smoke, nothing else behind him. No text, no letters, no logos, no building, no sky, no flag. Cinematic front lighting with catchlights in the eyes, skin detail, sharp focus. The smirk a touch wider and more mischievous, one eyebrow slightly raised, as if he knows something you do not.
